title: Address remaining pkgcheck findings
description: Fresh pkgcheck still fails on broad/manual items after R CMD check cleanup: many exported functions lack examples, coverage is 67.7% versus the 75% threshold, GitHub default branch is master, goodpractice/lintr reports 1904 style findings, and 18 exported function names duplicate names in other packages. Treat examples and coverage as the highest-value work; branch rename, broad lintr cleanup, and duplicate exported names need maintainer/API decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh pkgcheck has no failing checks or all remaining failures are explicitly documented as accepted manual exceptions.
